name: Sanjay Kapoor
review: I topped up my prepaid number today but the amount hasn't reflected even after 2 hours. I used my credit card, got a success message, yet my balance is still zero. This is affecting my work calls, please fix ASAP!

name: Rohan Joshi
review: Mujhe bahut dikkat ho rahi hai, pichle do din se mere broadband ki speed bahut low hai, mera plan 100 Mbps ka hai par speed sirf 5-6 Mbps aati hai. Video call bhi kabhi bhi cut ho jati hai. Router ko theek se restart kar ke dekha, phir bhi koi farak nahi pada. Kripya isko turant theek karein, kyunki kaam bahut pending hai.

name: Divya Iyer
review: Hey, can u tell me what recharge packs are available for my prepaid number? I want to know the data vs talk time options. Thanks.

name: Aditya Nair
review: I am really upset. My last bill shows ₹1,299 but my plan says I should be paying ₹899. I didn't change anything, yet I'm being overcharged. Please fix this ASAP, I can't afford extra charges.

name: Kavya Reddy
review: My phone keeps dropping calls after the first minute, especially when I'm on the road. It's kinda annoying but not urgent, just wanted to let you know.

name: Vikram Kapoor
review: Bhai, since yesterday evening my network is totally down in my area (Sector 5, Pune). Calls get dropped instantly, data never loads and even SMS won't send. I need it for work and urgent family matters, so this is causing massive trouble. Please fix it ASAP, this is unacceptable.

name: Ritu Bhat
review: Dear team, my latest bill shows Rs.1999 while my plan is Rs.1499. I have been on this plan for 6 months and never faced extra charge before. Kindly check and refund the extra amount. Thanks.

name: Priya Patel
review: I was charged twice for my May mobile bill, both Rs. 899 amounts showing up. This duplicate billing is causing me trouble, please fix it ASAP and adjust my account. I need the extra charge removed now.
